fields.FIR_Description: It was alleged that goods worth about Rs. 2,00,000 (garments) were found missing from Oviya Fancy Store, a shop near Vennila Puram Shopping Complex in Erode. The matter was brought to Erode South PS on 2025-12-16, while the incident was placed on 2025-12-16 at roughly 15:15. The online submission was made by Harish Anand (9000000208). The complainant is associated with the business Oviya Fancy Store. A witness, Manoj Karuppasamy, reachable on 9000000054, was mentioned in the complaint. The complaint refers to Madhan Palanisamy, a relative of the suspect, reachable on 9000000295. Karthik Rajan (mobile 9000000091) was named as a possible person of interest.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspect allegedly posed as a customer and took items while staff were attending to others.
fields.Keywords: shop theft, stock, witness, shopping complex, suspect, mobile number, afternoon, associate
